name: submit_plan
title: Submit Plan
description: Records the write operations you intend to make (create_*, update_*, delete_*, add_*, remove_*, set_*, apply_*, fix_*, activate_*, rename_*, reorder_*, call_method) and returns a planId. Write tools on this server are rejected until the plan is approved with approve_plan, and each write must match one plan entry's tool and args exactly. Use before any write, then present the returned plan to the user for approval.

summary.description: Plain-English summary of what will happen and why.

changes.description: Ordered list of every mutating tool call you intend to make.

args.description: Exact args object that will be passed to the tool

name: approve_plan
title: Approve Plan
description: Approves a submitted plan so its writes can run, for ttlMinutes (default 15). Use after the user has explicitly approved the plan.

name: get_current_plan
title: Get Current Plan
description: Inspect the current plan's status, approved changes, and which ones have been consumed. Useful for recovering mid-execution.

name: create_record
title: Create Record
description: Create a record in any DocType.

name: update_record
title: Update Record
description: Update an existing record in any DocType.

name: get_record
title: Get Record
description: Get a single record from any DocType.

name: query_records
title: Query Records
description: Fetch records from any DocType with filters.

name: delete_record
title: Delete Record
description: Delete a record from any DocType.
